# Donngal of the Faoilean, one of the drowned on the Skerry (Stage 14; Book 8 section 07; Book 9 section
# 03; decisions S14-18 and S14-147 to S14-150): an adult on the 32 x 48 canvas, composited from
# the people generator's layers and drawn in the drowned's colder palette, water running from
# them. Drawn by Claude and flagged for the user's review (decision DH-2). Generated by
# assets/art/authoring/stage14_drowned.py; edit that script, not this sheet.
# appear and fade (6 frames each): water gathering off the rock and rising into the figure,
# and back; marked seated so the art lint does not hold their low frames to a standing size.

kind: sprite
palette: book07
size: 32x48
pivot: 16,47
footprint: 10x4
shadow: 16x5
facings: s n e w
placeholder: false
anim.idle: frames 4, ticks 16, loop
anim.shift: frames 4, ticks 30, loop
anim.speak: frames 4, ticks 12, loop
anim.walk: frames 6, ticks 5, loop
anim.run: frames 8, ticks 3, loop
anim.runstart: frames 2, ticks 4
anim.runstop: frames 2, ticks 6
anim.walkstart: frames 2, ticks 5
anim.walkstop: frames 2, ticks 4
anim.appear: frames 6, ticks 7
anim.fade: frames 6, ticks 7
event.footstep: walk 0, walk 3, run 0, run 4
pose.appear: seated
pose.fade: seated
